name: Interior Design Image Editing
author: codingdude

sections.description:
Interior Design Image Editing brings the power of AI to your WordPress Media Library. This plugin allows you to easily enhance and modify interior design photos directly within your site.

Whether you’re a designer showcasing concepts or a content creator decorating virtual spaces, this tool allows you to change colors, furniture, and layouts using smart AI-driven image editing.

You can also try the online AI Interior Design tool, prompts and ideas from MockoFun if you don’t have WordPress or don’t want to use a Replicate API kay.

Key Features:
– Edit images using AI right from the Media Library
– Customize interiors with AI-assisted decoration tools
– Easy-to-use and integrates seamlessly with WordPress
– Perfect for interior designers, decorators, and real estate websites

Credits

Developed by John Negoita

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/interior-design-image-editing/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to your Media Library, click on any image, and use the new Edit with AI options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require an API key or external service?

This plugin equires an API key from Replicate. Check plugin settings for more details.

Can I revert changes after editing?

Yes. The plugin saves edited images as copies so the original remains intact.

What types of edits can I perform?

You can change room elements like wall color, add or remove furniture, adjust lighting, and more — all powered by AI.
